caption: The step Daily plan of Sunsama after the planning agent had run: Planned for today with Call supplier 20 min, Draft Q4 report 2 hr, Review invoice batch 45 min and Plan hiring interviews 1 hr, the empty list Obstacles in my way, the buttons Share and Get started, and on the right the five planned tasks as cards with a start time and a length (19:00 Call supplier with a running timer 0:05 / 0:20, 19:20 Draft Q4 report 2:00, 21:20 Review invoice batch 0:45, 22:05 Plan hiring interviews 1:00), three of them marked Priority. The interface is in English. Three spots of our own test data (one task line in the list, one subtask line and one task card) are covered by boxes; no personal name, e-mail address or avatar is shown.

The public pricing page of Sunsama, sunsama.com/pricing, with the heading Only pay if you love it. and two plans: Pro Plan $17 per month, billed yearly (USD), One plan for busy professionals, with Unlimited usage, Unlimited integrations and AI + MCP + Zapier, and the line $22 per month, billed monthly; and Enterprise with the button Contact Us, SSO and SAML, SCIM + Audit Logs and Custom privacy and data requirements. A customer quote with a name and job title at the bottom edge is covered by a box.

The upgrade page inside the app: Keep your days on track with Sunsama Pro, Your trial ends Thursday, Dec 3, You've planned 1 day with Sunsama., the switch Monthly / Yearly (Save $60) with Yearly selected, $17/mo billed $204 yearly, the green button Continue with Sunsama Pro with the line Cancel anytime, and the first feature line Guided daily planning & shutdown. The button was not clicked and no card field was shown.

The Questions part of the same upgrade page with the answers to What happens if I don't upgrade? (Nothing is charged, we never asked for your card; when the trial ends you lose access to the workspace until you subscribe), How do I cancel? (Workspace settings, Billing, Manage billing and cancel; access stays until the end of the billing period; no refunds or prorated credits) and Why is there no free plan? The photo and job title of a customer quote at the top edge are covered by a box.
